businesses.business: Infusion therapy and medical equipment services

offering_description.value: InfuSystem helps hospitals, oncology practices, surgery centers and other healthcare providers continue treatment from the clinic to the home. It supplies infusion pumps, other durable medical equipment and disposables, and provides equipment rental, financing and biomedical service both on-site and at repair depots.

quotes.quote: InfuSystem provides Infusion pump sales & rental, financing, disposable products, DME, biomedical services, onsite service, depot service, device hub, pain management, and negative pressure wound therapy services to hospitals, oncology practices, surgery centers and other health care providers. With over 30 years of experience, InfuSystem is your trusted partner in care.

We provide last-mile solution for clinic-to-home health care where the patient’s continuing treatment involves complex durable medical equipment and services. InfuSystem has over three decades of delivering trusted and innovative therapy services to hospitals, oncology practices, surgery centers and other alternate site health care providers. InfuSystem delivers therapy services to support Oncology, Pain Management and Wound.

primary_products.value: Infusion pumps; enteral pumps; wound vacuum pumps; infusion disposables including needles and IV tubing

quotes.quote: InfuSystem offers an extensive selection of high-quality and competitively priced disposable products for health care providers delivering infusion therapies. Including Huber needles, syringe pumps, IV extension tubing, 5FU disposable pumps, ambulatory pumps, and more.
Ambulatory Infusion Pumps | Enteral Pumps | Pole-Mounted Pumps | Syringe Pumps | Wound Vac Pumps
